name: Shanghai MicroPort MedBot (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai MicroPort MedBot (Group) Co., Ltd. researches, develops, designs, produces and distributes surgical robotic systems for China and Europe. Its range includes Toumai, a laparoscopic surgical robot used in general, thoracic, gynecologic and urologic surgeries, and DFVision, a 3D electronic endoscope.
